fields.why: Table 1 chi-square p-values compare influenza positivity and the percentage vaccinated across 4 race/ethnicity groups and 5 age groups (rule 2 and rule 6, Table-1 composition tests).
Race/ethnicity (4 mutually exclusive groups) and age (5 groups) are the 3+ level SPDs tested; sex has 2 levels and study site is not an SPD.

There is one chi-square per characteristic, so omnibus. Age-specific VE 'varied by age group' with each VE judged only against 0, so the cross-age comparison is side by side; the flag is a false hit because the chi-square applies to Table 1, not to VE.
